confidence_notes: Overall low. Food and drink anchors come from Ushuaia cost-of-living indices (e.g., Numbeo, Wise, Livingcost, Expatistan) and a June 2026 Mundo Austral estimate. Sources are mostly dated Feb to Jun 2026, partly peso-quoted (so exchange-rate assumptions add error), and disagree most on meal prices; coffee and draught beer agree closely. Cocktail rests on one club price and is set at about 2x the beer anchor. Wine by the glass has no direct Ushuaia by-glass price and is set at about 0.9x the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge model estimates; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked, and July ski and school-holiday demand may push rates above shoulder levels. FX 0.6720 is the latest (18 Nov 2026) observation found, taken from the RBA overview and RSS feed as reported by search; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Ushuaia-specific aggregated sources; accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for Ushuaia as a Patagonian tourist gateway, not transfers from another city.
